## [0.35.2] - 2026-09-22

A patch release, closing out a handful of rough edges the 0.35.1 motion work
left behind: a token an OAuth refresh could delete, a caret shorter than its
neighbors, and a couple of buttons that widened while they worked.

### Changed

- Re-sending a request now sweeps a faint band across the dimmed response
  pane while the new one is on its way, instead of a plain, motionless dim -
  the stale response underneath stays just as readable.

### Fixed

- **A second click after fetching an OAuth token could delete it.** Clear sat
  to the right of Get Token, and a token landing slid the button left by
  Clear's width - a normal double-click on the same spot hit Clear instead
  and threw away the token that had just arrived. The action rail no longer
  moves once a token lands.
- The Connection Test button and the Add certificate button in Settings
  widened for as long as their request was in flight, shrinking the URL
  field beside Test and sliding Cancel sideways; both now hold their size and
  swap an icon in place instead.
- The form-data row's text/file switch changed its icon under the pointer
  that had just clicked it.
- The launcher and first-run screens now fade in like every other screen in
  that spot, instead of popping in with a hard cut.
- The row-picker caret between Send and Load Test - shown once a collection's
  CSV or JSON data file is bound - was a few pixels shorter than the buttons
  on either side of it.
